REFERRAL (Orchestrator, no verdict from me)

Whether the published Supervisor should expose the raw `stdout` Readable on the semver surface at all is a design ruling: Process and Session publish framed lines and emitter events instead, and `stdout` is now the only path by which a third face can read output. I rule only that what is published must be documented (R2).
